text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Right before summer camp ends, I'm looking for Nice Nature, when…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I won't be able to see this for a while…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And I wanted to reflect on some stuff.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm… stronger than I was before summer camp, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Doesn't just being by the sea make you emotional? There's a reason it's a primo date spot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I'll go back. I've got my mind all ready now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ready for the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Nice Nature's summer camp comes to an end.
